> has this issue been resolved for apple m1?
> Running into this error. Is there a workaround?

export PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1

This will fallback to CPU for this operation. If this is a big part of your training pipeline then there's likely a performance hit. But if it's only a small part then it may be ok.

comments.author: participant53
comments.body:
The following worked for me.

1. Installed pytorch in my working environment from here https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/
2. Then added the following code just before the code that was raising the error
```
import os
os.environ['PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK'] = '1'
```
